query: UPDATE app.job SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END, run_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN run_at ELSE $4::timestamptz END, finished_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN $5::timestamptz ELSE NULL END, locked_by = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN locked_by ELSE NULL END, locked_until = NULL, last_error = $6 WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'running' AND locked_by = $2 AND attempt_count = $3 RETURNING status, run_at
